title: Why Sanitary Tees Fail on Horizontal Drain Lines
description: Installing a standard sanitary tee on a horizontal waste line is a frequent installation error that leads to chronic blockages. Sanitary tees are designed primarily for transitioning flow from horizontal branches into vertical stacks. When installed on a horizontal run, the tight radius fails to direct solid waste smoothly along the direction of flow, causing debris to accumulate at the fitting junction. To ensure reliable solids transport and maintain proper hydraulic flow according to standard drainage principles, always use a combination wye and eighth bend or a long-sweep fitting for horizontal-to-horizontal waste pipe transitions.
